Summary: 10 requirements reviewed: 4 with issues, 6 without. 3 issues found (1 High, 1 Medium, 1 Low). Types: Vague_Language (1), Internal_Contradiction (1), Untestable_Requirement (1).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the customer within 60 seconds of a successful payment.
REQ-002: The system shall apply free shipping to all orders with a subtotal of $50 or more.
REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
REQ-004: Managers and finance staff who have completed security training shall be able to approve refunds.
REQ-005: Payment transaction records shall be retained for the audit retention period.
REQ-006: Customers shall be allowed to cancel an order after payment confirmation, provided the order has not yet been dispatched.
REQ-007: Customers shall not be allowed to cancel an order after payment confirmation, even if the order has not yet been dispatched.
REQ-008: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
REQ-009: The product search shall return results within 1.5 seconds for 98% of searches under 2,000 concurrent shoppers.
REQ-010: Customer payment card numbers shall be stored in encrypted form.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The term 'quickly' has no objective interpretation, so the requirement cannot be verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Replace 'quickly' with a measurable time threshold.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-006: Customers shall be allowed to cancel an order after payment confirmation, provided the order has not yet been dispatched.
IssuesIdentified.RelatedEvidence: REQ-007: Customers shall not be allowed to cancel an order after payment confirmation, even if the order has not yet been dispatched.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: REQ-006 and REQ-007 state incompatible cancellation rules for the same scenario.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Resolve which cancellation rule applies and correct the conflicting statement.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-008: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The phrase 'never reject' implies an absolute guarantee that cannot be objectively verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define a bounded rejection rate or acceptable failure rate.
